parsed.name: RPLIDAR 二维激光雷达
parsed.description: 用于获取周围环境二维距离与角度扫描数据的旋转式激光雷达。该设备可连续输出测距点，形成一圈扫描缓冲区，常用于机器人避障、环境感知、建图与定位实验。
parsed.description_en: A rotating 2D LiDAR used to acquire distance-and-angle scan data of the surrounding environment. It continuously outputs range measurements and maintains a recent full-scan buffer, making it suitable for robotics experiments involving obstacle avoidance, perception, mapping, and localization.

actions.description: 读取一个激光测量点，并更新当前扫描缓冲区。
actions.description_en: Read one LiDAR measurement and update the current scan buffer.

actions.description: 持续更新激光雷达测量数据。
返回线程模式下最近缓存的一圈测量结果。
actions.description_en: Return the most recent cached scan measurements for threaded operation.

actions.description: 在设定轮询时间内采集并返回一批激光测量数据。
actions.description_en: Collect and return a batch of LiDAR measurements over the configured polling interval.

actions.description: 停止激光雷达采集并关闭设备连接。
actions.description_en: Stop LiDAR acquisition and shut down the device connection.
